jobs.title: Subject Matter Expert, Legal
jobs.description:
About The Team

We are building AI systems that help people tackle complex, consequential work in the legal industry. Law demands careful reasoning, precise language, and sound judgment: understanding the facts, identifying the right questions, weighing competing interpretations, and helping clients decide what to do next. We see an opportunity for AI to help legal professionals work with greater rigor and focus more of their time on the problems that matter most.

Our team works across Research, Product, Engineering, and Go-to-Market to build AI capabilities and products for legal work. Our customers include the top law firms in the world as well as in-house legal departments of some of the largest businesses in the world. We translate the realities of practice into evaluations, training signals, and useful tools, with the ambition of making AI a trusted part of how lawyers research, analyze, draft, and advise.

About The Role

We are looking for a Subject Matter Expert in Law who brings the judgment and practical experience developed in a law firm to shaping the next generation of AI. You will help define what excellent legal work looks like, test where our models meet that standard, and turn your findings into better model behavior and product experiences.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role at the intersection of legal practice and AI development. You will work directly with legal materials, model outputs, evaluation rubrics, and product prototypes. Your expertise will help us tackle some of the hardest questions in legal AI, including how to assess reasoning when there is no single correct answer.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In This Role, You Will

Define the quality bar for what top-notch legal work looks like, drawing on real matters and the standards lawyers apply to research, analysis, drafting, document review, and client advice.
Design challenging, realistic AI model evaluations with representative facts, source materials, constraints, and deliverables, including cases that test ambiguity, competing arguments, and professional judgment.
Create and review reference work such as research memoranda, contract analyses, redlines, diligence findings, and draft legal documents that demonstrate strong reasoning and practical usefulness.
Develop rubrics that assess legal accuracy, issue spotting, factual grounding, citation validity, jurisdictional context, and the appropriate treatment of uncertainty.
Evaluate model outputs and complete legal workflows, identify recurring failures, and give researchers and engineers specific, actionable feedback supported by examples and corrected work.
Partner with Research on datasets, grading methods, and training tasks or environments that strengthen legal reasoning. Test whether model changes address the underlying problems and improve performance on new cases.
Work with Product and Engineering to identify valuable use cases, prototype workflows, and translate lessons from evaluations into experiences that fit how lawyers actually work.
Collaborate with legal professionals and design partners to refine our standards and test usefulness in practice, applying sound judgment around confidentiality, privilege, data permissions, and professional responsibility.

You Might Thrive In This Role If You

Have practiced law at a law firm, with substantial experience producing and reviewing work for real client matters. We care more about demonstrated judgment and quality of work matter over title or firm pedigree.
Bring deep expertise in one or more practice areas, such as commercial transactions, corporate law, litigation, or regulatory work, and curiosity about workflows beyond your specialty.
Are an excellent legal researcher and writer who can assess authorities, distinguish strong arguments from plausible ones, and explain how facts and context affect a conclusion.
Can make expert judgment explicit: explain why an answer is incomplete, a clause creates risk, or an analysis misses the central issue, and describe what better work would look like.
Enjoy working directly with AI tools, exploring their limits, and testing ideas systematically. You can collaborate closely with technical teams and communicate clearly across disciplines.
Take ownership in ambiguous settings and are willing to build the first version of an evaluation, reference document, rubric, or workflow, then improve it through feedback.
Care deeply about the quality and consequences of legal work, and are motivated by the opportunity to help shape how AI supports the profession.

Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have

Experience designing evaluations, benchmarks, datasets, or review frameworks for legal work or frontier AI systems.
A track record of improving legal workflows through technology, knowledge management, automation, or new ways of working.
Experience training or supervising lawyers, developing practice guidance, or translating complex legal concepts for different audiences.

jobs.title: Robotics Lab Technician
jobs.description:
We’re ALTEN Technology USA, an engineering company helping clients bring groundbreaking ideas to life—from advancing space exploration and life-saving medical devices to building autonomous electric vehicles. With 3,000+ experts across North America, we partner with leading companies in aerospace, medical devices, robotics, automotive, commercial vehicles, EVs, rail, and more.
As part of the global ALTEN Group—57,000+ engineers in 30 countries—we deliver across the entire product development cycle, from consulting to full project outsourcing.
When you join ALTEN Technology USA, you’ll collaborate on some of the world’s toughest engineering challenges, supported by mentorship, career growth opportunities, and comprehensive benefits. We take pride in fostering a culture where employees feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow.
Workplace:
On-site, 5 days per week
Location:
San Francisco, CA (Dogpatch neighborhood) 
Salary:
$90,000-$105,000
We are seeking a Robotics Lab Technician to be the versatile builder at the center of our prototype lab. You'll move fluidly between precision assembly, wiring and electrical integration, system bring-up, and acceptance testing to take robots from a kit of parts to a validated, working system. You'll install software and read logs, bridging the gap between hardware and software during bring-up, and you’ll troubleshoot and solve integration issues during testing and validation. We're looking for someone careful with their hands, organized about documentation, and comfortable collaborating with mechanical, electrical, controls, and software engineers in a fast-iterating environment.
Key Job Responsibilities

    • Assemble electromechanical robotic systems and subsystems (actuators, gearboxes, sensors, vision systems, wiring harnesses, PCBAs) from mechanical drawings, schematics, and work instructions, following torque specs and assembly procedures.
    • Kit parts against the BOM, stage hardware and fixtures, and set up assembly jigs and alignment rigs for each build.
    • Build first articles from prototype kits, provide engineering with actionable build feedback (DFx), and execute rework and engineering change orders (ECOs) as designs iterate.
    • Fabricate, route, and terminate wiring harnesses to documented pinouts with proper strain relief, bend radius management, and cable routing for moving assemblies.
    • Perform pre-power-on electrical verification (continuity, pinout, insulation, polarity) and board-level integration under ESD discipline.
    • Maintain build records, travelers, inspection checklists, and non-conformance reports (NCRs) ensuring full traceability. Redline and improve work instructions with each build.
    • Bring up newly built assemblies, verify actuator and sensor function, and run acceptance testing and performance characterization using standard and custom test equipment.
    • Use git and the Linux command line to install, configure, and run test and calibration software on robots; track software versions across the fleet.
    • Read logs and source code well enough to localize problems and provide engineering with actionable triage reports.
    • Collaborate with engineering to isolate integration issues, narrow root cause across mechanical, electrical, and software domains, and drive corrective actions into work instructions.
    • Keep the lab safe, organized, and ESD-compliant; track tooling, consumables, and inventory.
    • Drive continuous improvement and support prototype-to-production transitions by developing SOPs, assembly aids, and training materials.

Required Qualifications

    • 3-5+ years of hands-on experience assembling and testing electromechanical systems such as robotics hardware, precision mechatronic assemblies, aerospace/automotive hardware, or electronics assembly in a lab, prototype, or manufacturing environment.
    • Able to read and interpret mechanical drawings, electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and written work instructions to build and test complex hardware.
    • Proficient with hand and torque tools, basic crimping and soldering, and steady work with small fasteners and connectors.
    • Demonstrated ability to perform functional and acceptance testing using standard test equipment such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, and power supplies.
    • Experience performing quality inspections and maintaining detailed build records, including assembly travelers, inspection checklists, and non-conformance documentation.
    • Comfortable at a Linux command line running scripts, and willing to grow those skills.
    • Knowledge of ESD handling procedures and lab safety protocols for working with high-voltage electronics and heavy mechanical assemblies.
    • Clear communication, careful record-keeping, and safe work habits.

Preferred Qualifications

    • Associate's degree or technical certification in Electronics Technology, Mechatronics, Robotics, Mechanical Engineering Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience.
    • Experience assembling and testing robotic systems with high degrees of freedom, including familiarity with actuators, force/torque sensors, IMUs, encoders, and vision/camera systems.
    • Wiring harness fabrication experience including building to a pinout, connector assembly, and cable routing on moving assemblies.
    • Background in a robotics research lab, hardware startup, aerospace, or advanced electromechanical environment where rapid prototyping and tight engineering collaboration are standard.
    • Mechatronics training/coursework or electromechanical troubleshooting experience.
    • Some scripting ability (Python or bash) for test and calibration; basic familiarity with git, Docker, or networking.
    • Experience with ERP systems, MES, PLM, or lab management tools for tracking inventory, build status, component traceability, and hardware/software revision control.
Work Environment & Physical Requirements

    • On-site lab role; standing, bench work, and hands-on assembly for extended periods, including work in awkward positions and tight spaces.
    • Fine motor precision and close-vision work with small fasteners, connectors, and board-level components.
    • Lifting and maneuvering heavy robotic assemblies; use of required PPE.
    • Work around high-voltage electronics, powered actuators, and moving machinery.

Salary Range

    • $90,000-$105,000
    • The actual salary offered is dependent on various factors including, but not limited to, location, the candidate’s combination of job-related knowledge, qualifications, skills, education, training, and experience

new_jobs.title: Subject Matter Expert, Legal
new_jobs.description:
About The Team

We are building AI systems that help people tackle complex, consequential work in the legal industry. Law demands careful reasoning, precise language, and sound judgment: understanding the facts, identifying the right questions, weighing competing interpretations, and helping clients decide what to do next. We see an opportunity for AI to help legal professionals work with greater rigor and focus more of their time on the problems that matter most.

Our team works across Research, Product, Engineering, and Go-to-Market to build AI capabilities and products for legal work. Our customers include the top law firms in the world as well as in-house legal departments of some of the largest businesses in the world. We translate the realities of practice into evaluations, training signals, and useful tools, with the ambition of making AI a trusted part of how lawyers research, analyze, draft, and advise.

About The Role

We are looking for a Subject Matter Expert in Law who brings the judgment and practical experience developed in a law firm to shaping the next generation of AI. You will help define what excellent legal work looks like, test where our models meet that standard, and turn your findings into better model behavior and product experiences.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role at the intersection of legal practice and AI development. You will work directly with legal materials, model outputs, evaluation rubrics, and product prototypes. Your expertise will help us tackle some of the hardest questions in legal AI, including how to assess reasoning when there is no single correct answer.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In This Role, You Will

Define the quality bar for what top-notch legal work looks like, drawing on real matters and the standards lawyers apply to research, analysis, drafting, document review, and client advice.
Design challenging, realistic AI model evaluations with representative facts, source materials, constraints, and deliverables, including cases that test ambiguity, competing arguments, and professional judgment.
Create and review reference work such as research memoranda, contract analyses, redlines, diligence findings, and draft legal documents that demonstrate strong reasoning and practical usefulness.
Develop rubrics that assess legal accuracy, issue spotting, factual grounding, citation validity, jurisdictional context, and the appropriate treatment of uncertainty.
Evaluate model outputs and complete legal workflows, identify recurring failures, and give researchers and engineers specific, actionable feedback supported by examples and corrected work.
Partner with Research on datasets, grading methods, and training tasks or environments that strengthen legal reasoning. Test whether model changes address the underlying problems and improve performance on new cases.
Work with Product and Engineering to identify valuable use cases, prototype workflows, and translate lessons from evaluations into experiences that fit how lawyers actually work.
Collaborate with legal professionals and design partners to refine our standards and test usefulness in practice, applying sound judgment around confidentiality, privilege, data permissions, and professional responsibility.

You Might Thrive In This Role If You

Have practiced law at a law firm, with substantial experience producing and reviewing work for real client matters. We care more about demonstrated judgment and quality of work matter over title or firm pedigree.
Bring deep expertise in one or more practice areas, such as commercial transactions, corporate law, litigation, or regulatory work, and curiosity about workflows beyond your specialty.
Are an excellent legal researcher and writer who can assess authorities, distinguish strong arguments from plausible ones, and explain how facts and context affect a conclusion.
Can make expert judgment explicit: explain why an answer is incomplete, a clause creates risk, or an analysis misses the central issue, and describe what better work would look like.
Enjoy working directly with AI tools, exploring their limits, and testing ideas systematically. You can collaborate closely with technical teams and communicate clearly across disciplines.
Take ownership in ambiguous settings and are willing to build the first version of an evaluation, reference document, rubric, or workflow, then improve it through feedback.
Care deeply about the quality and consequences of legal work, and are motivated by the opportunity to help shape how AI supports the profession.

Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have

Experience designing evaluations, benchmarks, datasets, or review frameworks for legal work or frontier AI systems.
A track record of improving legal workflows through technology, knowledge management, automation, or new ways of working.
Experience training or supervising lawyers, developing practice guidance, or translating complex legal concepts for different audiences.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

new_jobs.description:
We’re ALTEN Technology USA, an engineering company helping clients bring groundbreaking ideas to life—from advancing space exploration and life-saving medical devices to building autonomous electric vehicles. With 3,000+ experts across North America, we partner with leading companies in aerospace, medical devices, robotics, automotive, commercial vehicles, EVs, rail, and more.
As part of the global ALTEN Group—57,000+ engineers in 30 countries—we deliver across the entire product development cycle, from consulting to full project outsourcing.
When you join ALTEN Technology USA, you’ll collaborate on some of the world’s toughest engineering challenges, supported by mentorship, career growth opportunities, and comprehensive benefits. We take pride in fostering a culture where employees feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow.
Workplace:
On-site, 5 days per week
Location:
San Francisco, CA (Dogpatch neighborhood) 
Salary:
$90,000-$105,000
We are seeking a Robotics Lab Technician to be the versatile builder at the center of our prototype lab. You'll move fluidly between precision assembly, wiring and electrical integration, system bring-up, and acceptance testing to take robots from a kit of parts to a validated, working system. You'll install software and read logs, bridging the gap between hardware and software during bring-up, and you’ll troubleshoot and solve integration issues during testing and validation. We're looking for someone careful with their hands, organized about documentation, and comfortable collaborating with mechanical, electrical, controls, and software engineers in a fast-iterating environment.
Key Job Responsibilities

    • Assemble electromechanical robotic systems and subsystems (actuators, gearboxes, sensors, vision systems, wiring harnesses, PCBAs) from mechanical drawings, schematics, and work instructions, following torque specs and assembly procedures.
    • Kit parts against the BOM, stage hardware and fixtures, and set up assembly jigs and alignment rigs for each build.
    • Build first articles from prototype kits, provide engineering with actionable build feedback (DFx), and execute rework and engineering change orders (ECOs) as designs iterate.
    • Fabricate, route, and terminate wiring harnesses to documented pinouts with proper strain relief, bend radius management, and cable routing for moving assemblies.
    • Perform pre-power-on electrical verification (continuity, pinout, insulation, polarity) and board-level integration under ESD discipline.
    • Maintain build records, travelers, inspection checklists, and non-conformance reports (NCRs) ensuring full traceability. Redline and improve work instructions with each build.
    • Bring up newly built assemblies, verify actuator and sensor function, and run acceptance testing and performance characterization using standard and custom test equipment.
    • Use git and the Linux command line to install, configure, and run test and calibration software on robots; track software versions across the fleet.
    • Read logs and source code well enough to localize problems and provide engineering with actionable triage reports.
    • Collaborate with engineering to isolate integration issues, narrow root cause across mechanical, electrical, and software domains, and drive corrective actions into work instructions.
    • Keep the lab safe, organized, and ESD-compliant; track tooling, consumables, and inventory.
    • Drive continuous improvement and support prototype-to-production transitions by developing SOPs, assembly aids, and training materials.

Required Qualifications

    • 3-5+ years of hands-on experience assembling and testing electromechanical systems such as robotics hardware, precision mechatronic assemblies, aerospace/automotive hardware, or electronics assembly in a lab, prototype, or manufacturing environment.
    • Able to read and interpret mechanical drawings, electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and written work instructions to build and test complex hardware.
    • Proficient with hand and torque tools, basic crimping and soldering, and steady work with small fasteners and connectors.
    • Demonstrated ability to perform functional and acceptance testing using standard test equipment such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, and power supplies.
    • Experience performing quality inspections and maintaining detailed build records, including assembly travelers, inspection checklists, and non-conformance documentation.
    • Comfortable at a Linux command line running scripts, and willing to grow those skills.
    • Knowledge of ESD handling procedures and lab safety protocols for working with high-voltage electronics and heavy mechanical assemblies.
    • Clear communication, careful record-keeping, and safe work habits.

Preferred Qualifications

    • Associate's degree or technical certification in Electronics Technology, Mechatronics, Robotics, Mechanical Engineering Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience.
    • Experience assembling and testing robotic systems with high degrees of freedom, including familiarity with actuators, force/torque sensors, IMUs, encoders, and vision/camera systems.
    • Wiring harness fabrication experience including building to a pinout, connector assembly, and cable routing on moving assemblies.
    • Background in a robotics research lab, hardware startup, aerospace, or advanced electromechanical environment where rapid prototyping and tight engineering collaboration are standard.
    • Mechatronics training/coursework or electromechanical troubleshooting experience.
    • Some scripting ability (Python or bash) for test and calibration; basic familiarity with git, Docker, or networking.
    • Experience with ERP systems, MES, PLM, or lab management tools for tracking inventory, build status, component traceability, and hardware/software revision control.
Work Environment & Physical Requirements

    • On-site lab role; standing, bench work, and hands-on assembly for extended periods, including work in awkward positions and tight spaces.
    • Fine motor precision and close-vision work with small fasteners, connectors, and board-level components.
    • Lifting and maneuvering heavy robotic assemblies; use of required PPE.
    • Work around high-voltage electronics, powered actuators, and moving machinery.

Salary Range

    • $90,000-$105,000
    • The actual salary offered is dependent on various factors including, but not limited to, location, the candidate’s combination of job-related knowledge, qualifications, skills, education, training, and experience

new_jobs.title: Medical Content Writer/Reviewer Subject Matter Expert
new_jobs.description:
JOB TITLE : Medical Subject Matter Expert (SME) – USMLE Content Writer/Reviewer
Location : Remote – U.S.-based candidates only
Engagement Type : Contract / Freelance
About the Role :
We are seeking experienced Medical Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to develop and review high-quality educational and assessment content aligned with the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE). SMEs will support the development and/or review of USMLE Step 1 and Step 2 CK content, including clinical vignettes, multiple-choice questions, answer options, rationales, topic overviews, and related learning materials.The ideal candidate combines strong clinical or medical science expertise with experience in medical education, assessment development, and USMLE/NBME-style content.
Key Responsibilities :
Write and/or review USMLE-style multiple-choice questions and clinical vignettes.
Develop clinically relevant scenarios that assess application, reasoning, diagnosis, management, and next-step decision-making.
Create plausible distractors, correct answers, and evidence-based rationales.
Review AI-generated or AI-assisted medical content for clinical accuracy, relevance, and quality.
Identify and correct factual errors, inconsistencies, ambiguity, unsupported clinical reasoning, or inappropriate distractors.
Align assessment and learning content to applicable USMLE content outlines and competencies.
Develop and/or review topic overviews and supporting learning content.
Ensure content reflects current U.S. clinical guidelines, standards of care, and medical practice.
Incorporate stakeholder and peer-review feedback during revision cycles.
Follow established editorial, assessment, and quality standards.
Meet project deadlines and production expectations.

Subject Matter Areas :
Candidates should have expertise in one or more of the following areas:Internal Medicine
Family Medicine
Emergency Medicine
Surgery
Pediatrics
Obstetrics & Gynecology
Neurology
Psychiatry
Pathology
Pharmacology
Physiology
Microbiology / Immunology
Biochemistry / Molecular Biology
Anatomy
Behavioral & Social Sciences

Required Qualifications :
MD or DO degree from an accredited medical school.
U.S. clinical training and/or substantial experience with U.S. medical education.
Strong knowledge of clinical medicine and/or foundational medical sciences relevant to USMLE Step 1 or Step 2 CK.
Familiarity with USMLE content expectations and NBME-style assessment formats.
Ability to interpret medical evidence, clinical guidelines, and standards of care.
Excellent written communication, critical-thinking, and analytical skills.
Strong attention to detail and ability to provide clear, actionable feedback.
Ability to work independently within defined project guidelines and timelines.

Preferred Qualifications :
Board certification or board eligibility in a relevant medical specialty.
Completion of or current participation in a U.S. residency or fellowship program.
Experience teaching medical students, residents, or other healthcare professionals.
Experience writing or reviewing USMLE, NBME-style, or medical board-preparation content.
Experience developing clinical vignettes, single-best-answer MCQs, and evidence-based rationales.
Previous work with medical publishers, medical education organizations, assessment providers, or EdTech companies.
Experience reviewing AI-generated medical or assessment content.
Familiarity with assessment quality principles, including item difficulty, discrimination, distractor quality, bias, and accessibility.

Required Skills :
Medical / clinical subject matter expertise
USMLE Step 1 and/or Step 2 CK content knowledge
NBME-style item writing and review
Clinical vignette development
Clinical reasoning assessment
Evidence-based medical content development
Blueprint and competency alignment
Medical content quality assurance
AI-assisted content review
Strong written communication
Attention to detail
Ability to work within structured authoring and review workflows

new_jobs.description:

Description

Alta Planning + Design
is looking for an experienced Senior Civil Engineering Associate
to join our team in Oakland and serve as our Bay Area Technical Leader
.

This is a unique opportunity for somebody passionate about sustainable transportation and positively impacting our communities who's ready to take the next step in their career with a rapidly growing company in Oakland. In this role, you will provide technical leadership on the design of a variety of sustainable transportation projects, with a focus on making a positive impact on communities around the Bay Area and Northern California.

If you are looking for a mission-focused company that is an industry leader in active transportation design, TDM, roadway safety, greenways, and sustainable mobility, apply with us today!

About Alta

Alta is a mission-driven company working to mitigate climate change and advance safety and social justice by shaping sustainable, people-centered communities. We bring together expertise across planning, design, engineering, education and encouragement programs, and community engagement to help communities thrive. Our work is grounded in the belief that how places are designed and experienced has a profound impact on equity, health, and opportunity—and that people should always be at the heart of those decisions.

Founded in 1996, Alta was at the forefront of the active transportation movement and has spent nearly 30 years partnering with communities to imagine a more connected, resilient, and inclusive future. Today, with more than 225 staff across the United States and beyond, we are a global leader in creating environments that support everyday life, strengthen human connection, and respond to the challenges of a changing world. Alta offers the opportunity to collaborate across disciplines, contribute to meaningful work at every scale, and be part of a team committed to making lasting, positive change for people and the places they call home.

Day to Day

Our Senior Civil Engineering Associate will help foster livable communities across the Bay Area and Northern California. Projects range from natural surface trails to large arterial multi-use paths, and from Complete Streets to regional and multi-state bicycle and trail networks.

Day-to-day responsibilities for this role include: Lead business development activities across the Bay Area market, nurturing relationships with clients and partners.
Provide technical leadership across offices, serving as a senior resource on roadway design and engineering approach.
Lead and oversee QA/QC processes to ensure design deliverables meet high standards of quality, accuracy, and constructability.
Mentor staff across offices, supporting their professional development and career growth.
Manage a variety of transportation projects from design through construction, driving the success of engineering projects and influencing the sustainability of the work we do.
Prepare schedules, budgets, and scopes of services for projects, and manage project budgets.
Implement best practices and process improvements to enhance project delivery efficiency and effectiveness.
Balance staff workload across projects.
Attend industry conferences and professional organization meetings to conduct business development and present on Alta's work.
Collaborate closely with staff from Alta's other offices and with Alta's colleagues within the Trilon Group of companies.

Qualifications

Required

This position requires a combination of skills, experience and education including, but not limited to 15+ years of experience as a Transportation Engineer in a consulting environment or public entity; 5+ years as a Project Manager; 3+ years managing staff.
Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering.
Professional Engineering (P.E.) license in the State of California.
Demonstrated technical leadership in roadway design, including senior-level design review and QA/QC of multidisciplinary deliverables.
Experience in, and knowledge of, the field of active, non-motorized transportation.
Demonstrated understanding of and experience preparing Plans, Specifications and Estimates (PS&E) packages for roadway projects, and a detailed understanding of project management principles, methods, and techniques.
Ability to guide staff members and manage internal team expectations.
Exhibits strong initiative and ability to capitalize on opportunities to enhance Alta's position in the marketplace.
Ability to manage competing priorities and multiple simultaneous projects involving cross-functional project teams within budgetary and schedule constraints.
Ability and willingness to travel.
Excellent professional ethics, leadership skills, accountability, and decision-making capabilities.
Good presentation skills.
Working knowledge of MS Excel, Word, MS Project or equivalent.
Proficiency in civil engineering software such as GEOPAK, InRoads, AutoCAD, Civil 3D, OpenRoads Designer, and MicroStation.
Proficiency in an enterprise-wide resource planning and project management tool.

Preferred

There are a number of additional skills, experience, and education that would be beneficial to this position including, but not limited to: Master's degree in Civil Engineering or a related field of study.
Experience developing or implementing QA/QC programs for design projects.
Experience working with Bay Area cities, counties, transit agencies, and Caltrans.
Experience managing large projects for both private and public clients.
Experience using Deltek Vantagepoint.
Active participation in industry-relevant professional associations and committees.

What We Offer

Flexible Schedule

Alta offers a flexible, hybrid work schedule where most employees work from home three days per week. In-office days support our collaborative culture, one of our core values.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is indicated in the posting. This range reflects the company’s good faith estimate of the compensation for this position at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location.

Additional Benefits
: Wellness reimbursement up to $800 annually, Alta Gets Around benefit of up to $900 annually, 5-year travel award, and professional development opportunities
